user.title: Swiss Earthquakes (SED)
user.description: Sets up earthquake tracking (Swiss Seismological Service SED) around a location. Latitude/longitude default to your Home Assistant home location. Add the integration again for a different radius or location.

reconfigure.title: Change location or filters
reconfigure.description: Change the location, the radius, the minimum magnitude or the time window of this entry. The sensors and map markers keep their ids and history; the device name and the entry title follow the new radius after the reload. One query goes to the SED service first to verify the values.

error.cannot_connect: The SED service could not be reached. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_radius: Enter a radius greater than 0 km.
error.invalid_days: Enter a time window of at least 1 day.

abort.already_configured: This location/radius combination is already configured.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The entry was updated and the integration reloaded.

certificate.message: The SED service at {host} rejected the connection because its TLS certificate is invalid ({error}). This has to be fixed by the service operator; Home Assistant keeps retrying.

unreachable.message: The SED service at {host} could not be reached ({error}). Home Assistant keeps retrying.

certificate.title: SED earthquake service: invalid TLS certificate
certificate.description: The connection to {host} is rejected because the server's TLS certificate is invalid ({error}). Nothing is wrong with your installation: the certificate has to be renewed by the service operator (Swiss Seismological Service, ETH Zurich). The earthquake sensors and map markers stay unavailable until then and recover on their own; this notice disappears with the next successful refresh.

unreachable.title: SED earthquake service unreachable
unreachable.description: The SED service at {host} has not answered for several refreshes in a row ({error}). Check your internet connection; if it is fine, the service itself is down. Sensors and markers recover on their own; this notice disappears with the next successful refresh.

earthquake_detected.name: Earthquake detected
earthquake_detected.description: Triggers when the Swiss Seismological Service records a new earthquake within the radius of a location — optionally only from a minimum magnitude.

recent_earthquake.name: Recent earthquake
recent_earthquake.description: Passes while the newest earthquake of a location happened within the last hours and reaches the minimum magnitude.
